messages:
sam: quick alignment thread — we need a lean MVP for the Console visibility surface. scope candidates: cost-by-route, error time-series + groups, trace pointers (no full flamegraphs), and a lightweight alerts view. looking to lock scope and launch gates by EOD tomorrow.
arun: from infra side: two hard constraints: query latency for dashboard panels P95 < 2.5s, and ingestion pipeline must support 1h backfill at launch (longer backfill adds infra and complexity).
maya: CS note — pilots want per-route cost and error % by model version. they also asked for a simple drilldown to the originating request id for debug.
tom: runtime ops — trace retention and sampling are the wildcards. sugg: default 0.5% sampling, but auto-capture traces on error (>=500 or timeout). we can provide a manual `capture_trace` API.
grace: eng-frontend — UI budget is small. suggest a single dashboard with tabs: Overview (top routes, cost spike chart), Errors (fingerprints), Traces (quick-links). defer advanced filtering to phase 2.
sam: thinking minimal launch criteria: 1) Overview dashboard shows top-20 routes by cost and traffic; 2) Error groups with time-series and top-5 fingerprints; 3) Trace quick-links for sampled traces and on-demand capture; 4) Per-route cost estimates; 5) Docs and migration guide.
arun: concrete SLOs proposal: ingestion lag < 6m P95, dashboard panel render <2.5s P95, backfill finish <36h for last 7d. note: 36h backfill will increase cost vs 24h.
maya: customers prefer 7d visibility but accept 24-48h initially if we communicate. recommend 48h backfill for first release.
tom: infra cost delta for 48h backfill ~= +8% monthly. need finance approval.
sam: decision trade options: A) ship with 24h backfill + clear plan to extend; B) ship 48h backfill now to satisfy pilots. leaning B if finance OK. quick thumbs?
grace: thumbs up for B — less churn for pilots.
arun: conditional yes if we can automate backfill and not block ingestion.
maya: +1. I can coordinate pilot expectations.
sam: tracing decision: default 0.5% sampling + trace-on-error + on-demand capture. also expose feature flag to bump sampling per-customer. OK?
tom: yes — will add `feature.visibility.tracing_sampling` and `feature.visibility.trace_on_error` flags. example config in infra:```json
{"feature.visibility.tracing_sampling":0.005, "feature.visibility.trace_on_error":true}```
ci-bot: test run triggered: visibility-integration-tests #124 -> started at 2112350100
arun: routing/cost tagging — we need `x-route-id` header at ingress for accurate per-route cost. if SDKs can't adopt immediately, we'll surface heuristic mapping via path+model for initial estimates.
maya: pilot customers can enable `x-route-id` quickly for accurate billing. I'll include in migration docs.
sam: UX/labeling: whenever heuristic used show a small badge `estimated` with hover text explaining confidence band and how to get exact numbers. grace can mock.
grace: will deliver mock with badge and a confidence band visualization (low/med/high) by Thurs.
sam: gating checklist (draft):
- ingestion pipeline deployed to prod canary and passes integration tests
- overview dashboard renders and passes perf test
- tracing: sampling flag and on-demand capture implemented + docs
- cost: heuristic per-route numbers available, and header-based exact path validated with pilot customer
- errors: grouping working on sample traffic and automated rollback if group-flooding occurs
- comms: pilot runbook + public docs ready
- finance: sign-off on infra delta for 48h backfill

arun: will own pipeline canary and perf metrics. ETA for canary: Tue EOD.
tom: I'll own tracing flags and on-demand capture API. ETA Mon.
grace: UI mocks ETA Thu.
maya: pilot coordination and docs ETA next Wed.
sam: final decision on backfill within 24h after finance check. any blockers?
tom: one: retention config needs a small schema change in meta store. low risk.
arun: two: we need to cap dashboard query concurrency to protect the service; will add soft quota.
sam: ok. action items summarized:
- arun: deploy pipeline canary + perf report (ETA Tue).
- tom: tracing flags + capture API + meta-store change (ETA Mon).
- grace: UI mocks + estimation badge (ETA Thu).
- maya: pilot doc + migration plan for `x-route-id` (ETA Wed).
- sam: gather finance sign-off on backfill delta + confirm launch gate (ETA Fri).
ci-bot: reminder: run `./scripts/visibility_smoke_test.sh` after canary deploy
sam: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after canary results. :rocket:
